hashBasis: Per URL: normalized HTML text or complete PDF bytes; see each row's hashBasis
note: Automated re-check of every official URL behind this dashboard. HTML changes compare normalized text. PDF changes compare all bytes, including compressed streams; a PDF flag may be metadata-only and does not prove a wording or value change. A human must re-read the source before any value is changed. Only an HTML raw-body difference with identical comparable text is recorded as noise. A 'blocked' row means the venue's edge refused this datacenter runner (HTTP 403/401/429 or a bot redirect); it does not mean the page is gone. Those URLs are covered by a manual read, and the last manual result is on the Sources page.

transcription.note: Only the window that overlaps the recommended trip is transcribed here, because that is the window the day plan acts on. Every row was read from the official PDF's REG CLOSES column, which is the only place the late-registration cut-off is published as a clock time. Blank cells in the PDF (Day 2 restarts, the RaceDay events with no guarantee) are blank here too; they are never inferred.
